title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts
author: lennartb-
summary: ZoomIt DemoMirror default Ctrl+Alt+9 binding collides with AltGr+9 character entry on German and Danish layouts; the same AltGr/Ctrl+Alt class is already tracked in open issue #37143.

status.label: Duplicate / tracked elsewhere
status.detail: The report is a clear 0.101 manifestation, but it belongs under the broader open ZoomIt AltGr shortcut issue rather than a separate design thread.

next_action.label: Post duplicate guidance
next_action.reason: Link the existing open AltGr tracker and preserve the workaround/evidence from this report.

judgment.rationale: This is a genuine 0.101-visible regression for users of non-US layouts, but it is the same underlying ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl+Alt shortcut collision already tracked in #37143, which was updated with a 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ report.
evidence: The reporter says AltGr+9, used for ] on German layout, triggers ZoomIt DemoMirror after updating to 0.101.2362.
A Danish keyboard commenter confirms AltGr+9 triggers DemoMirror and changing DemoMirror to Ctrl+0 moves the collision to AltGr+0.
#37143 is open, labeled Product-ZoomIt, and tracks ZoomIt activating on AltGr+key instead of Ctrl+key.
#37143 has a 2026-08-27 comment reporting the same 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ AltGr+9 mirror activation.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate comment pointing to #37143 while preserving this issue as additional German/Danish 0.101 evidence.

issue_context.summary: A newly enabled default ZoomIt DemoMirror shortcut blocks AltGr character entry on non-US layouts, but the broader AltGr behavior is already tracked.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 introduced the user-visible default DemoMirror conflict for this reporter.
German AltGr+9 is needed to type ].
A Danish keyboard user reproduced the same with AltGr+9 and showed that changing the shortcut moves the conflict to the corresponding AltGr character.
Open issue #37143 tracks ZoomIt activating on AltGr+key instead of Ctrl+key and has a fresh 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ confirmation.
inferences: The 0.101 default made an existing AltGr/Ctrl+Alt handling limitation more visible for DemoMirror users.
A standalone fix for only Ctrl+Alt+9 would likely miss the broader international-layout problem.
issue_context.analysis: The report is valid and useful, but duplicate handling avoids splitting the same ZoomIt AltGr investigation across two open issues. The comment should point maintainers and reporters to the canonical issue and note that this issue adds German/Danish DemoMirror evidence.
initial_investigation: Duplicate search found #37143 as the open canonical ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl shortcut issue.
Closed related issues #46656, #44362, #37197, and #40016 show prior AltGr conflicts on non-US layouts.
src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt.cpp contains the DemoMirror command and ZoomIt shortcut handling surface.

comment.body: This looks like the same underlying ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl+Alt shortcut collision tracked in #37143. The 0.101.2362 DemoMirror default made it show up as AltGr+9 on German and Danish layouts, and #37143 already has a fresh 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ report for the same class of failure. I suggest closing this as a duplicate of #37143 while keeping this issue linked there as additional German/Danish DemoMirror evidence.
